result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a few visible content and horizontal clipping issues.

issues.description: The promotion badge on the lower restaurant card displays “−0%,” which is nonsensical and looks like a data or formatting error.
issues.suggestion: Suppress zero-value discounts or display a valid positive discount percentage.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip is visible only as an empty sliver at the screen edge, making the category row look accidentally clipped.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel padding or initial scroll position so the next chip shows enough text to communicate that the row is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” carousel is cut off at the right edge, including its restaurant name and delivery information.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent carousel peek spacing and constrain card text with an ellipsis so partially visible cards do not show abruptly clipped labels.
